content.title: Chipotle Is Offering a BOGO Deal to Tattooed Customers on Friday the 13th
content.text: The offer is inspired by fan trends of being “tatted like a Chipotle bag.” Published on March 10, 2026 01:55PM EDT Credit : Chipotle NEED TO KNOW Chipotle is offering fans with a tattoo a BOGO deal on March 13The deal is inspired by the trend of being “tattooed like a Chipotle bag”The chain is also partnering with hip-hop artist Swae Lee on a temporary tattoo sheet at one Miami location Friday the 13th will be a big day for tattoed Chipotle fans. The popular chain will offer a one hour buy-one-get-one deal to customers with tattoos on March 13 from 3 to 4 p.m. local time at participating locations in the U.S., Canada, the U.K., France and Germany. Customers can redeem this offer by showing up to the restaurant with permanent, temporary, or drawn-on tattoos and purchasing an entree item. The promotion is available for up to five free menu items per check and requires the purchase of an entrée of equal or greater value per free item. According to a press release from the chain, the offer is inspired by fan trends of being “tatted like a Chipotle bag.” The bags feature writing on them that resemble tattoos, and the resulting phrase blew up when it was used to describe Adam Levine in 2019, according to the release. The deal also takes inspiration from the Friday the 13th “flash tattoo” tradition of tattoo shops creating “flash sheets” featuring pre-designed tattoos for the day, the release shared. Related Stories "Bringing this promotion back for Friday the 13th further establishes our connection with the tattoo community,” said Stephanie Perdue, Chipotle's Interim Chief Marketing Officer, in a press release. Miami Chipotle-goers get another bonus – a limited-edition temporary tattoo flash sheet co-created by hip-hop artist Swae Lee. "‘Tatted like a Chipotle bag' is really about self-expression," the artist said in the release. "It was cool to bring it into the real world and create designs that actually feel like me." This sheet is exclusively available with a purchase at the Midtown Miami Chipotle location from 3 to 4 p.m. on Friday, March 13, while supplies last. According to the press release, the first Chipotle BOGO deal for tattooed customers in 2025 led to the company’s highest-ever sales during the 3 to 4 p.m. non-peak hour. Chipotle has been on a roll with freebies this year. The brand celebrated National Tortilla Chip Day at the end of February by handing out free chips and queso.
